dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Hehe, Bluey is really amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who is Bluey...?

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Bluey is my friend! She's from the mountains. She plays with me and takes me to many fun places in the mountains. We eat lots of delicious fruits too, and she lets me touch little rabbits and little cats.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: She's really nice and really cool! When she came out of the forest, the branches and vines clattered as they retreated automatically. When she took me to cross the river, the moss on the stones also crept away, returning only after the two of us had crossed the river.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: But that's not all! Hmm... the birds and snakes also follow her instructions. I accidentally lost my things several times, and Bluey asked the birds to find them in the forest for me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seeya.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Bye. Um, don't go into the mountains whenever you like, or you'll make Bluey unhappy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That really is amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Hehe, I know, right? Oh, oops... Bluey told me not to tell other people about her...

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: I—I need to apologize to her the next time I enter the mountains...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to meet Bluey.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: No way! She's scared of strangers and doesn't usually wanna meet other people.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Hmm. Actually, why did she meet with me then? I'm not sure... It's just... When I was playing in the mountains one time, I saw a rabbit that couldn't move because of a rock that was on top of it. I removed that rock and gave it a fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Although it didn't eat the fruit... it nodded at me before hopping into the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: It rained heavily after that on that day, and I couldn't find my way home, so I hid under a big rock.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Hehe... that's when Bluey came to me with lots of fruits. She told me to eat my fill and then guided me out of the mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: But my parents didn't believe what I told them after I got home. They just told me to never enter the mountains by myself again.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Wait for me to come back. Once I do, I'll tell you Big Sis Fujin's story!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't sneak into the mountains by yourself. It's dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: I know. Uncle Luo and Grandpa Lu always say that too, but... Hehe, they can't keep an eye on me all the time, can they?

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: The mountains really aren't that dangerous. Bluey and Big Sis Fujin are there too. It's been a while since I've played with Bluey, too.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: I wanted to introduce Grandpa Lu to Bluey earlier, but she said that wasn't a good idea, so I dropped the idea.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're both adepti, so I'm sure everything will be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Really? But... if they're fine, why couldn't I find Bluey anywhere when I went to play in the mountains after that, then?

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: I walked along the river for ages, eating several large fruits and getting hungry two or three times along the way, but I couldn't find her anywhere. In the end, I lay down next to a giant tree and fell asleep. It was in my dream that I saw her.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: She told me to eat until I was full after waking up and then go home first because she was busy with something.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: After I woke up, I ate the fruits Bluey left next to me and then went home like she told me to...

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Bluey didn't tell me what she was busy with... but maybe I can help her!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Bye! Remember to say hello for me if you see Bluey and Big Sis Fujin, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, Bluey gave you fruits?

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Yes. There was a big pile of fruits next to me when I woke up. Some were sweet, and some were sour, and some were really difficult to bite into. Oh, some of them spurted juice all over my clothes when I bit them. Fortunately, I was next to a river, so I could wash my clothes there.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder when Bluey will finish with whatever she's doing. I miss her and Big Sis Fujin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's follow that adeptus's instructions and search for the scattered adeptal energy!
